Legionaries in presence of Centurion use the Centurion's morale score.

name: Faa Nomad
special: The travelling folk of the blue desert. Expert trackers, skilled at ambush and escapes.
A group of eight or more includes a Lvl 2 leader.

name: Faa Sniper
special: Headshot: at the start of each combat round, before initiative is determined, the Sniper picks one foe in line of sight for elimination. If at the end of the combat round the Sniper still has line of sight on the target, they are shot and reduced to 0 HP, with no Save possible. If the PC targeted has negative HP, this attack is instantly fatal. Creatures without heads suffer d10 damage instead.
Hidden: Snipers blend into the environment and cannot be targeted if they do not move. When they fire, the target can make an INT Save to pinpoint their location.
raw_excerpt: FaaSniper Biological LVL3(12HP)/AV12/ML+6/ENC1 ATK:Headshot(Special)/CurvedBlade(d6). Headshot... shot and reduced to 0HP, with no Save possible... Creatures without heads suffer d10 damage instead. Hidden: ...cannot be targeted if they do not move.

name: Seeker of Eyeless Wisdom

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.damage: d6, STR save vs lifted and thrown

special: Walkers of the Eyeless Path, who seek endarkenment within the subterranean halls of their hidden temples.

Brain Burster: an embolism catalysed by psychic malice. For each combat round that the Seeker focuses their attention on a target, the target takes unblockable damage, with no to-hit roll required. This damage starts at 2 and doubles each turn, unless the Seeker's focus is broken, or if they switch to a new target. Creatures without a brain cannot be harmed by this attack.

name: Master of Eyeless Wisdom

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.damage: 2d8, STR save vs lifted and thrown

special: Masters of the Eyeless Path, who achieved endarkenment and now guide lesser minds upon the road. Self-blinded and legless, they levitate above the azure dust.

Prescience: Eyeless Masters telepathically predict the assaults of their opponents, always moving ahead of the blow. They cannot be harmed with any attack unless the attacker learns to shield their intentions, achieved with an opposed PSY Save. Stripped of their prescience, Eyeless Masters have AV11.

name: Cacklemaw
special: Lurking laughing hyena-women. Fight in packs, with little regard for their own safety. Snap at opponents' faces in close quarters with their powerful teeth.
A group of eight or more will include a Cacklemaw Virago (see below).
raw_excerpt: Cacklemaw Biological LVL2(8HP)/AV13/ML+8/ENC2d6 ATK:Blade(d8)+Bite(d6)/Crossbow(d8). A group of eight or more will include a Cacklemaw Virago.

name: Cacklemaw Virago
special: Virago is the title given to the largest, meanest, and most cunning Cacklemaw warriors. They lead their smaller sisters into battle, and must be seen to savour the violence lest they be challenged by one of their underlings. For this reason Virago will never retreat from combat if other Cacklemaw are alive to witness it.
combat_note: Morale listed as Special: will never retreat from combat if other Cacklemaw are alive to witness it.

name: Jigsaw Courtier
special: Bearer of a figment of the Jigsaw Autarch. See d4 Autarch Figment table for the effects of the figment.
Autarch Figment (d4): 1 EYE - Bearer's eye becomes a hole of infinite depth. Bearer can cry lances of paradox energy (d10, beam, hypergeometric). Bearer gains the Hypergeometric creature type.

Autarch Figment (d4): 2 GUT - Bearer cradles the Autarch's paradoxical gut inside their body, boosting their resilience. Bearer gains +3 AV and +1 Level. Bearer gains the Hypergeometric creature type.

Autarch Figment (d4): 3 MAW - Bearer's flesh blossoms into a mouth of the Jigsaw Autarch. At close range they make an additional bite attack every round (d10, hypergeometric). Bearer gains the Hypergeometric creature type.

Autarch Figment (d4): 4 NERVES - Bearer's nerves are intertwined with the otherworldly neurons of the Jigsaw Autarch. Bearer gains +1 to INT, PSY and EGO. Bearer may extrude the Autarch's nerves to entangle an opponent (DEX Save vs -5 AV). Bearer gains the Hypergeometric creature type.
combat_note: Stats vary by rolled Autarch Figment (e.g. +3 AV / +1 Level on a GUT result).
raw_excerpt: JigsawCourtier Biological/Hypergeometric LVL4(16HP)/AV13/ML+4/ENCd4 ATK:BladedTesseract(d6,hypergeometric). Bearer of a figment of the Jigsaw Autarch. d4 AUTARCHFIGMENT: 1 EYE / 2 GUT (+3AV,+1Level) / 3 MAW / 4 NERVES.

name: Child of the Darkling Sun
special: Dark-robed dreamers, hooded in black silk and blinded by their desire to transcend lucid reality.

Darkling Dream: the Child falls asleep. While they sleep, they manifest a nightmare into the waking world, with no Save possible. The nature of the nightmare varies: stairs may become slides into pits of razors, the sun may have your father's face, doors may seal shut or open into indescribable vistas. Waking the Child (either through damage or anything else that would wake a sleeper) ends their dream's impingement on our reality.

name: Nightmare Herald
special: The formless musicians who attend to the Daemon Sultan Azathoth in the dreaming chaos at the terminus of space and time. The Children summon these pipers and flautists into our reality to aid their rituals.
Sleep: targets fall into a nightmare-wracked sleep and cannot act. They can be woken by direct damage, or anything else that would wake a sleeper.
Feast of Dreams: at the start of the round, a Nightmare Herald regenerates d6 HP for each sleeping creature nearby, allied or enemy. This effect can resurrect the Herald from apparent 'death'.
combat_note: Feast of Dreams regenerates d6 HP per nearby sleeper and can resurrect the Herald from apparent death.
